description_en: Retrieves a paginated list of promotional products with detailed information
description_zh: 分页获取推广商品列表及详细信息
kebab_example: aliyun market describe-distribution-products --page-number 1 --page-size 10 --filter Value=cmj0000000 Key=supplierName --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeDistributionProducts

parameters.help_en: The number of promotional products per page
parameters.name: page_size

fields.help_en:
The search label category. Valid values:

code: the commodity code of the promotional product
name: the name of the promotional product
supplierName: the name of the promotion service provider
fields.help_zh:
搜索标签类别，取值：

code：推广商品Code
name：推广商品名称
supplierName：推广服务商名称
fields.name: key

fields.help_en:
The search tag value:

code: the product code to search for
name: the product name to search for
supplierName: the supplier name to search for
fields.help_zh:

code: 测试商品code
